agentCards.name: Help Center Agent
agentCards.description: Searches the IT knowledge base for answers to common issues. Returns relevant articles with step-by-step instructions.

skills.name: Knowledge Base Search
skills.description: Search for IT help articles and known solutions. Queries the internal knowledge base using keywords or a description of the issue, matches against existing articles covering common problems like VPN access, email sync, and account resets, and returns the most relevant article along with step-by-step remediation instructions.
examples: How do I reset my VPN password when I am locked out of the corporate network?
My Outlook email stopped syncing after the latest update, what troubleshooting steps should I take?
I am trying to log into Figma but I am getting a license error, is there a knowledge base article for this?
